Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Ireland openers, Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie take guard. It will be Keshav Maharaj to start proceedings with the ball for South Africa.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! South Africa have managed to get over 180 runs on a wicket that doesn't quite seem like the flat one we saw in the first game. Ireland aren't going to have the easiest of chases as there is something in the wicket for the bowlers, especially for the slower bowlers. Will Ireland be able to level the series? Find out soon as the chase is not far away.

Ireland started the game in a completely contrary fashion to their performance in the first game. They bowled with good discipline and exploited the conditions to get some good swing. After bowling well for the first 11 overs, Andy Mcbrine conceded 26 runs in the 12th. Gareth Delaney picked up the two set batters in the very next over but after that, there was pure carnage. Gareth Delany bowled well conceding 24 runs in his four over and taking 2 wickets despite going for 15 runs in his last over. Josh Little got over his last game performance in style conceding just 20 in his full quota of 4 overs and bowling a magnificent last over conceding only 4 runs.

The Proteas started really slow losing the out-of-form Quinton de Kock early once again. Rassie van der Dussen could not get going and the pressure started building on Reeza Hendricks who seemed in good touch. He fell 8 short of a fifth consecutive half-century but took 40 balls to get there. Aiden Markram started the acceleration when he took a liking to Andy McBrine, hitting him for three sixes and a boundary in the 12th over. Both Hendricks and  Makaram departed soon after but Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller and Dwaine Pretorius came out with aggressive intent to push South Africa over the 180 mark.

South Africa have overcome a slow start to the innings to end with 182 on the board. Ireland did really good in the first half of the innings but all their good work was undone towards the end. South Africa were 58 for 2 in 11 overs and scored 124 in the last 9 overs. Ireland have their task cut out now as they look to level this series when they return for the run chase.
Full and wide again, Wayne Parnell carves it away towards deep backward point for a single. Only 4 runs come off the final over as South Africa finish on 182/6!
Just inside the tramline. Pacy delivery, full and wide, Parnell can't reach it.
Swing and a miss! Fuller and angled across the left-hander. Wayne Parnell hangs deep and has a big swipe across the line but does not connect.
Well bowled! This is very full and outside off, David Miller jams it out towards long off for just one more.
Around off, this is driven through cover-point for a run.
Misses out! Juicy full toss, outside off, David Miller slaps it straight to the man at the cover fence and it will only be a single.

Wayne Parnell walks to the crease and will be playing second fiddle to David Miller who will look to play out the last over. Barry McCarthy has been really expensive today but will be given the responsibility to end the innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, Mark Adair gets his man but Dwaine Pretorius has done his job. This is on a fullish length and well outside off, it is the off-paced delivery. Dwaine Pretorius looks to lift it over long off but mistimes it badly. The ball goes high off the toe end of the bat and towards cover-point. The skipper, Andy Balbirnie settles under it and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Sweetly timed! Full and wide, Dwaine Pretorius steps down the track and just plays a checked drive that rockets through the cover region and into the fence.

SIX! What a strike! Short of a length and outside off, Dwaine Pretorius fetches this one and has a baseball-type swing at it. The ball hits the middle of the bat and flies over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Full and wide, sprayed beyond the tramline outside off. Wide called.
Back of a length, outside off, Dwaine Pretorius makes room and slaps it away to the right of the man at extra cover. Andy Balbirnie gets a hand on it and the batters get a couple of runs.
This is courageous and perfectly executed bowling from Mark Adair. Nails yet another yorker and outside off, Miller can only manage to jam it out on the off side for a single.
Adair gets the yorker in on leg stump, Miller tries to clip it past square leg but the ball goes off the pads and does extremely well to get back for the second. Two leg byes then.
Mark Adair (3-0-31-0) returns for his last over.

FOUR! Nicely done by Dwaine Pretorius. Little tries to repeat the trick and bowls it back of a length, following the batter past the leg stump. Pretorius backs away and manages to guide it really fine, past the man at short third man for a boundary.
Slower and shorter, angling in from around off. David Miller can only manage to pull it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Missed opportunity but well bowled as well. This is banged in halfway down the track and outside off, Miller looks to ramp it over the man at short third man but gets an under edge straight to that man.
Full again and outside off, this is drilled down to long on for one.
Full and wide, Dwaine Pretorius has a swing at it but misses.
Dwaine Pretorius makes his way out to the middle and there is only one way he is going to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! The pyrotechnics from Heinrich Klaasen have come to an end as Josh Little sends him packing. This is dug in short and slower by Little, following the batter. Heinrich Klaasen tries to back and loft it over covers but gets hurried on. The ball flies off the outside edge and goes straight down the throat of the man at short third man. Andy McBrine over there takes a simple catch and what a turnaround it has been for Little from the first game.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Full and wide, full enough that the batter can't get under it. Heinrich Klaasen squeezes it towards deep point for one. 28 runs came off that over!

FOUR! Oh, no! Cruel for the bowler this. Barry McCarthy switches to around the stumps and nails the wide yorker. Klaasen shuffles past the off stump and gets a bottom edge that beats the keeper and goes into the fine leg fence.

SIX! Back-to-back! Barry McCarthy seems nervy out there and serves a juicy full toss outside off. Heinrich Klaasen takes full advantage of it and thumps it right back over the bowler's head for another maximum. 23 already off this over.

NO BALL AND SIX! This is going from bad to worse now for Ireland and this is a poor, poor delivery from Barry McCarthy. Almost a chest-high full toss, over middle, Heinrich Klaasen stays back and hits it baseball style. The ball is sent flying over the cow corner fence and out of the ground. A Free Hit will now follow.
FOUR! Even the good deliveries are now going for boundaries. Full and wide, Heinrich Klaasen shows fast hands as he slaps it away behind point for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! Attempted yorker on middle stump, Heinrich Klaasen drills it right back and almost takes off his skipper in the process. The ball rockets into the long on fence.
WIDE! McCarthy tries to push it wide of the off stump but bowls it a bit too wide for the umpire's liking.
This is banged in short and over leg stump, David Miller swivel-pulls it down to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Barry McCarthy (2-0-16-1) has been brought back into the attack.
Full and at the toes, clipped away to deep mi-wicket for a single. 20 runs come off that over, just what South Africa needed.
FOUR! This is carnage! Length again, outside off, David Miller powers it past the man at wide long on who never really stood a chance of cutting that one off. Another boundary.
WIDE! Full and wide, spilled beyond the tramline outside off and left alone by Miller.
Here comes the knuckle-ball from Mark Adair, fuller and around off. Miller can only manage to play it back to the bowler.

SIX! What a shot! Fuller and wider, David Miller just holds his shape and just drives through the line, times it to perfection and the ball sails over the extra cover fence for another massive hit. Miller seems to be in the mood now.
SIX! Whacked away! A length ball, outside off and there's no pace on it. David Miller stays put and clobbers it away hard and way, way over the long on fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and looks to bowl the wide yorker but misses his mark.
Starts off with a slower short ball, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen pulls it down to wide long on for a single.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack.

Bowls a googly to end the over. Gareth Delany serves this full and just outside off, David Miller fends the ball back down the pitch. 15 runs of the last over from Gareth Delany and it ruins his bowling figure having conceded just nine runs in his first three.
SIX! David Miller has his first boundary! Gareth Delany flights this full and outside off, David Miller swings and just manages to clear the long off fielder for a maximum.
Bowls this quicker in the air, a fraction short and in line with the stumps, David Miller goes on the back foot and fends it back to the bowler!
Gareth Delany serves this full and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen knocks this down to long off for a run and gets off strike.
FOUR! Make that two in a row! This is short and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen moves back in the crease and thumps this towards the deep mid-wicket boundary for four more runs.
FOUR! Gareth Delany begins with a really full delivery on middle, Heinrich Klaasen gets on one knee and sweeps the ball to deep backward square leg for a well-hit boundary!
Serves this on a good length just outside off, Heinrich Klaasen taps this with soft hands towards point and takes a quick single. Six singles in the over.
Josh Little goes short once again and outside off, David Miller is hitting these hard but straight to the fielder as he finds the man deep point this time.
Josh Little angles this into the pad from a good length. Heinrich Klaasen clips this towards deep backward square leg for just a run. The crowd is happy that it is just singles at the moment.
Josh Little goes a fraction short outside off, David Miller cuts this had to deep backward point and gets just a run. He had hit this well and the crowd cheer.
Goes 'round the wicket to the right-hander and bangs this in short outside off. Heinrich Klaasen pulls this to deep square leg for a single.
Josh Little serves this full and angled into the pads, David Miller clips the ball towards long on for a single.
Serves this on full on middle and leg, Heinrich Klaasen fends this back towards the bowler. End of a very successful over as two wickets have fallen!
Josh Little (2-0-8-0) is back on.
WIDE Straying down leg on a fuller length as Heinrich Klaasen looks to work this leg side. Misses and is called wide.
Slower through the air and well outside off, this is punched through cover-point for a run.
Flighted full outside off, David Miller looks to fend and gets beaten on the outside edge.
The skipper, David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Gareth Delany with a double-strike and Ireland are back in front. This is dragged down around leg stump but is a bit quicker. Aiden Markram looks to muscle it away off the back foot but gets hurried on a bit. Markram tries to force the big shot but the ball goes off the higher part of the part and towards deep mid-wicket. Harry Tector picks it up a bit late but dives forward well to take the catch. The dangerous Markram departs and Delany is elated.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: A tad shorter and around middle, this is pulled away in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Gareth Delany gets rid of the in-form Reeza Hendricks now. This is on a nagging length and it is a bit quicker, bowled around middle and leg. Hendricks moves past the leg stump, trying to maneuver it leg side but the ball just skids on and rattles into the leg stump. Hendricks falls short of a record fifth consecutive fifty and the stand is broken.

SIX! A third maximum in the over and Aiden Markram has turned the game on its head here. This is short and turning into the pads. Markram makes a bit of room and nails it over the cow corner fence for a biggie. 26 runs of the over! South Africa may get going now.
WIDE! Andy McBrine fires this one full and wide outside off. Aiden Markram leaves this one alone and the umpire indicates that this is wide.
Andy McBrine flights this one full and angling into stumps and Aiden Markram clips the ball through mid-wicket for a brace.

SIX BANG! Back-to-back sixes! Andy McBrine goes short and in line with the stumps, Aiden Markram rocks back and wacks the ball just over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a maximum! Aiden Markram is getting a move on here!
SIX! Easily done! This is flighted, around middle, Mark Adair takes a step down the track and just times it perfectly and all the way over the long off fence for a maximum.
FOUR! This is been lifted back over the bowler. Andy McBrine serves this full and o0n middle. Aiden Markram lofts this with good placement as he gets this straight to the boundary for four runs.
Andy McBrine bowls this full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks works this to long on for a single.
Gareth Delany serves this full outside off, Reeza Hendricks knocks this down to long off to take a run and keep strike.
Short and wide outside off, Aiden Markram goes on the back foot and cits the ball to deep point for a run.
Gareth Delany drops this short and in line with the stumps, Reeza Hendricks mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Serves this on middle and leg, Reeza Hendricks gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to make room.
Gareth Delany flights this full outside off, Aiden Markram gets down the wicket and gets an inside edge onto his pads and rolls towards short third man for a single.
Gareth Delany serves this full and in line with the stumps, Aiden Markram rocks back in the crease and punches this towards cover.
Length, turning into the pads, Aiden Markram turns it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
A bit quicker and shorter, on middle. Reeza Hendricks goes deep in his crease to work it towards mid-wicket for just a single.

Drinks! Ireland have done well so far and have restricted the South African batters with good discipline. They will be hoping to continue this way after the break. With the wicket falling just before the break, Aiden Markram makes his way out to the middle and will look to build another partnership with Reeza Hendricks. They have a lot of work to do here to get to a decent total.

OUT! CAUGHT! The pressure was telling and Rassie van der Dussen has thrown his wicket away. Nicely tossed up, around leg stump. Van der Dussen steps down the track but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball. Van der Dussen tries to force the big shot over long on but ends up lofting it straight towards the fielder over there. Mark Adair takes a comfortable catch and South Africa lose their second.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter delivery, around off, Reeza Hendricks backs away and taps it through covers for one more.
A tad shorter and at the stumps, this is played off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Looking for two but will have to settle for one. Around middle and leg, Reeza Hendricks works it in front of mid-wicket and picks up a single. The 50 is up now for South Africa.
On the pads again and this is flicked away behind square on the leg side for a run.
On the pads, this is worked 'round the corner for a single.
Yet another dot ball! On middle and leg, Rassie van der Dussen looks to use his feet and work it leg side but the ball goes nowhere.
This is dragged down over middle and Rassie van der Dussen mistimes the pull shot towards short fine leg.
Huge shout for LBW from the bowler but it is turned down. Flatter delivery, around middle and le, Rassie van der Dussen yet again looks to use his feet but overruns a gets hit on the pads.

Rassie van der Dussen getting a little edgy out there. This is floated into leg stump, van der Dussen looks to dance down the track and slog it away but gets beaten in flight and the ball thuds into his pads.
Gareth Delany has been given the ball now.
Floated up, around off, the ball just sticks in the surface and takes Hendricks by surprise who does well to block it out.
On the shorter side and around middle, this is pulled away down to wide long on for just a single.
Nicely bowled! McBrine sees Rassie van der Dussen coming down the track and just holds it back a touch. Rassie tries to check his shot but gets a leading edge towards short cover.
Quicker and a bit shorter now, outside off, this is played off the back foot towards deep point for one more.
Slides it into middle, van der Dussen clips it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
On a fullish length and outside off, Hendricks strokes it away towards sweeper cover for one.
Andy McBrine (1-0-7-0) has been brought back into the attack having bowled one over in the powerplay.

A bit of a mix-up out there in the middle but no harm is done. On a good length again and around off, Rassie van der Dussen just dabs it down towards cover-point and looks for the single but his partner sends him back. Just the single off the over then.
This is angled into middle, on a length and Hendricks just nudges it leg side for a quick single.
Reeza Hendricks getting a bit frustrated out there now. Little comes from around the wicket and hits the length hard, outside off. Hendricks looks to slap it away but misses.
Another dot ball and Ireland tightening the screws after the wicket. Good length, a bit wider and this is tapped straight towards point.
Swing and a miss! Good length, going across the right-hander this time. Reeza Hendricks stays in his crease and has a big swipe across the line but fails to connect.
Little serves it on a length and close to the off pole, the ball just nips back in a bit and Hendricks manages to keep it out on the off side.

Excellent comeback from Barry McCarthy after getting hit for a boundary early in the over, just 5 runs and a wicket off it. back of a length, over off, Rassie van der Dussen gets back to make the block. At the end of the Powerplay, South Africa are 42/1!
Goes full and straight now, this is driven straight to mid on.
Good length, outside off and shaping away. Rassie van der Dussen looks to chase this one but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Rassie van der Dussen has made his way out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Quinton de Kock's miserable run of form continues as he gets out for another low score. This is banged in short and over middle and leg. It is there to be hit and de Kock looks to muscle it away. De Kock gets gets good timing on it but hits it flat and hard. The ball goes quickly towards deep mid-wicket where Curtis Campher takes a sharp catch. De Kock was looking desperate out there and Barry McCarthy has taken full advantage of it.
Commentary.Howout: c Curtis Campher b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Smart batting, rotating the strike after the boundary. Around the top of off, played with soft hands towards cover for a quick single.
FOUR! Clean strike! This is full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks stays legside of the ball and just hits through the line, thumping it over mid on for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy (1-0-11-0) is back on.

Quinton de Kock goes for a release shot. Josh Little bowls this on a good length and just outside off. Quinton de Kock tries to power this but mistimes it just over the mid on fielder as they complete a brace.
Quinton de Kock has been beaten a few times today! Josh Little serves this on a good length outside off, Quinton de Kock hangs his bat to dry and gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is slightly full and shaping into the batter, Reeza Hendricks plays with soft hands towards short cover and takes a quick single.

FOUR! This has been put away! Josh Little goes short once again and the ball sits up nicely outside off, Reeza Hendricks pulls this over the fielder towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary! Reeza Hendricks looking in good touch once again.
This is a fraction short and angling wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks slashes at it and misses.
Josh Little has got the ball to swing back in. This is served on a good length and pitching on middle. Reeza Hendricks is beaten on the inside edge as it hits his body.
Josh Little is into the attack now.
Beaten! This is on a perfect length, in that channel around off and de Kock plays inside the line of the ball yet again.
On a fullish length and slanted across the left-hander, Quinton de Kock looks to push it out on the off side but the ball zips past the outside edge.
WIDE! This is pitching really wide outside off on a fuller length. Clearly past the tram line and is called wide by the umpire.

Mark Adair goes full and in line with the stumps, Reeza Hendricks looks to work this leg side and gets an inside edge into his pads. The ball rolls to the offside and they take a single. Huge appeal, turned down by the umpire and Andy Balbirnie opts not to review.
Full and angling into the pads, Reeza Hendricks looks to clip this down leg and hits his pads and rolls to short fine leg.
FOUR! This has been dispatched! Mark Adair is full and wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks has room to swing his arms as he plunders this over the infield to the deep cover fence for a boundary.
Mark Adair bowls this full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks knocks this straight to the cover fielder.
Full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks taps this towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
Good delivery as this beats the outside edge once again. Barry McCarthy serves this on a good length and just outside off. Reeza Hendricks is clueless as it passes him.
This is full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks punches this through the point region and gets a couple of runs.
FOUR! Width on offer and hammered away. A bit fuller and well outside off, this time Reeza Hendricks throws the kitchen sink at it and gets it past backward point for yet another boundary.

FOUR! Edgy boundary! On a good length and around off again, this one nips away off the deck. Reeza Hendricks has a tentative push at it and gets an outside edge that runs away well past the man at first slip and into the fence.
McCarthy starts off with a length ball around off and shaping away. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and pushes it out towards cover.
Barry McCarthy is brought on as first change.
Mark Adair serves this on a good length and just outside off, Quinton de Kock pushes at the ball and gets beaten.
This one is in line with the stumps and on a good length, Reeza Hendricks looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge towards point.
Beaten! Good comeback from Mark Adair as he serves this on a good length and gets the ball to nip away. Beats the outside edge of the batter.

FOUR! This could have been stopped but instead, Reeza Hendricks gets his first boundary! Mark Adair serves this a fraction short and outside off, Reeza Hendricks punches this through point and a misfield allows the boundary to run to deep point for four runs.
This is really close to the tram line and on a full length. Reeza Hendricks leaves it alone and the umpire feels that this is just inside.
Gets the ball slightly close to the stumps and back of a good length, Reeza Hendricks looks to cut and gets beaten on the outside edge.
WIDE! Mark Adair begins with a full delivery, really wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks leaves this alone and is called wide by the umpire!
Mark Adair to bowl from the opposite end.

FOUR! Edged and runs away fine! Andy Balbirnie flights this full outside off and gets the ball to turn away from the left-hander. Takes an outside edge and flies through the vacant slip area to straight third man for South Africa's first boundary!
Andy McBrine goes full and outside off, turning into the stumps. Reeza Hendricks plays this to long on and takes a run.
Slower in the air and served full outside off, Quinton de Kock taps the ball towards short third man and take a single.
Andy McBrine goes quicker and full outside off, Quinton de Kock punches this to the cover fielder.
This is flighted full outside off, Quinton de Kock knocks this towards cover.
Andy McBrine begins with a quicker delivery fired into the pads, Reeza Hendricks works this down to long on for a single.

We are ready for play! The two umpires are out in the middle and so are the Irish players. The South African opening pair of Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks make their out to the middle as well. Ireland have opted to bowl with spin as Andy McBrine has been handed the new ball. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - Claude Hendersen is pitchside. He says that the wicket has a good grass cover and there will be consistent bounce but it is a bit dry. This means that the slower bowlers will get a bit of help and teams will be looking to use the small boundaries square of the wicket. Ends by saying that it will be interesting to see if the team winning the toss will bat first or bowl first.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller (C) (In for Tristan Stubbs), Wayne Parnell, Dwaine Pretorius, Keshav Maharaj, Lungi Ngidi and Tabraiz Shamsi.
Ireland (Unchanged XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Gareth Delany, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy and Josh Little.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they will have a BOWL first.

Ireland on the other hand, have been so close yet so far, way too often recently. Their batting order has been in outstanding form with some batter or the other playing a blinder. They need to be a little more disciplined in their bowling if they are to get over the line. The bowling at the beginning of the innings and towards the end still proves to be an issue for this side. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling still need to put their best forward but the middle order has been on fire. It was Lorcan Tucker and George Dockrell who looked in fine nick in the last game but we have seen what Harry Tector and Gareth Delany are capable of. Will today be the game that they turn up and get the better of their much-fancied opponent? We will find out soon as we look forward to the toss and the teams in a bit…
